cases.disposition_reason: TablePro opens on the connections screen with no --page flag. Clicking Development in the list and pressing e opens Edit connection. The action row shows Test connection, Cancel, Save, and Save & connect, and the host is dev-db.internal.acme.io. That frame has no Connection saved, no Connected · Pos…, no Connection time…, and no Query 1. Cancel returns to the Development detail.

acceptance_receipt.precondition: Development edit form open at 120x40 before Test, Save, Save & connect, or Cancel

cases.entry_path: tablepro with no --page, click the connection, press e
cases.return_path: Cancel returns to that connection's detail

cases.disposition_reason: Test, Save, Save & connect, and Cancel are separate results on distinct edits. With motion paused, Test connection on renamed Devtest leaves Edit connection open and paints ⠋ on the Test connection button. The list still shows Development. That frame has no Connected · Pos…, no Connection time…, no Connection saved, and no Query 1. With motion reduced, Production shows ✓ Connected · Pos…. The full sentence Connected · PostgreSQL 16.3 · 12 ms is not painted: connections.rs render_form caps the card with width.min(84) and truncates the status after the last button. Analytics shows ✗ Connection time…. The full sentence Connection timed out after 10 s is not painted. Save on renamed Devnote closes the form, shows Connection saved and Devnote, and does not show Query 1. Pressing e reopens Edit connection on Devnote with the four buttons and Connection saved still visible. Save & connect on renamed Prodlink with motion paused closes the form, shows Connection saved and ⠋ Opening SSH tunnel…, and does not show Query 1. The same action on renamed Locallink with motion reduced reaches Query 1 and Connected to Locallink. Cancel on renamed Staging returns to Staging and staging-db.acme.io. Nope is gone. Connection saved, both test results, and Query 1 are absent.

acceptance_receipt.precondition: paused Test connection stays busy on unsaved Devtest at 120x40

cases.action_sequence: On separate launches, run Test connection while paused on a renamed Development form, Test connection with reduced motion on Production and on Analytics, Save a renamed Development form, Save & connect while paused on a renamed Production form, Cancel a renamed Staging form, and Save & connect with reduced motion on a renamed Local PostgreSQL form.
cases.expected_results: Test leaves the form open and does not save. A paused test stays on the busy button. A reduced test shows the truncated success or timeout glyph. Save closes the form with Connection saved and does not open the workbench. Save & connect saves and starts connecting. Paused motion stays on Opening SSH tunnel. Reduced motion opens Query 1. Cancel returns to the original connection.
cases.forbidden_effects: Cancel writes the edit. A paused Test shows a finished connection result. Plain Save shows Query 1 or a test result. The paused Save & connect frame shows Query 1.
